name: graph_summary
author: 2f7893e5
description: Summarises the size and density of a whole graph. Use it for questions like 'How big is this network?', 'How many nodes/edges does it have?', 'How dense or sparse is it?' or 'How many connections does a node have on average?'. Works on any graph or registered subgraph: directed or undirected, weighted or unweighted (weights are ignored). Returns one object with nodes, edges, density (m/(n(n-1)) for directed graphs, 2m/(n(n-1)) for undirected; 0 when there are fewer than 2 nodes), avg_degree (2m/n, i.e. in + out for directed graphs), isolated_nodes (nodes with no edges) and, for directed graphs, avg_out_degree and avg_in_degree (both m/n). It does not list or rank individual nodes.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph or registered subgraph to summarise (see list_graphs).
